title: CollisionShape2D and CollisionPolygon2D doesn't scale like graphics
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e)

### System information

Windows 10 - NVIDIA RTX 2070S (Desktop)

### Issue description

Depending on project settings, Godot seems to scale visuals differently than `CollisionShape2D`s and `CollisionPolygon2D`s.

I've noticed that, depending on window/resolution/scaling settings, it's like the collision shape is located a bit bellow the shape that is drawn.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open attached MRP.
2. Open project settings
3. Set viewport resolution to your Windows OS resolution (1080p, 4k, etc)
4. Play project
5. Hover mouse over hexagon and circle. The shapes should change color when the mouse is over them. This is triggered by `mouse_entered()` and `mouse_exited()` signals emitted by a `CollisionShape/Polygon2D` nodes that exactly match the visuals!
6. Notice how the shape and the collision shape seems to be misaligned. The collision shape seems to be lower on the screen. It is more noticeable if you try to enter the mouse slowly from above the shapes. It seems the scaling happens differently for the collisions and the visuais. Or maybe it's a bug on the mouse coordinates system.
7. Change mode to "Exclusive Fullscreen" and notice how the bug doesn't happen.
8. Same goes if you keep "Windowed" mode but reduces viewport width and height by 1 pixel. No bug this way.

I've actually tested 81 different configurations (!!) and documented the testing processes in an spreadsheet.

I've included the results as a PDF in the MRP to guarantee access, but you can also open it in Google Sheets at [this link](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MYcPS_uzu5cvCHHUNSazhR9p3Z3myNH5ZN8jWYojKIA/edit?usp=sharing).

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[scaling-bug.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26230648/scaling-bug.zip)
